sources.title: gemma-3-270m: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-3-270m is a lightweight, open-weight text-generation model from google built from the same research as Google's Gemini models. This pre-trained variant contains 270 million parameters and was trained on 6 trillion tokens with a knowledge cutoff of August 2024.
